description: Adorn your floors with the Premium Sakarya rug collection by Home Dynamix. This Persian-inspired rug collection features traditional borders that frames scroll patterns and floral accents with center medallions that will complement your existing home décor. Machine woven from soft polypropylene yarns, these Premium Sakarya rugs are sure to give a cozy underfoot. Stain and fade resistant, these rugs will withstand the day-to-day wear and tear. Perfect for high traffic areas. Enhanced with durable jute backing that creates stability and provides long-lasting shape and beauty.
